summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical report titled "MONTHLY NEW RESIDENTIAL CONSTRUCTION, AUGUST 2022" (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 3a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total housing starts by region (West, South, Midwest, Northeast) and month-over-month percent changes for August 2022, covering the starting month of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. The data shows the South led with 885,000 units compared to the West's 361,000, meaning the West was not the leading region. The West's month-over-month growth rate (1.1%) was also not the highest (South led with 24.5%). The document covers only August 2022 and does not contain data for subsequent months or years. Values for August 2022 are preliminary and subject to revision in later reports within the specified period.
